tokenize_string: tokenize a string into a list of tokens using sacrebleu v14 international tokenization
detokenize_string: detokenize a list of tokens or token string back into a plain text string
process_string: process a string with character-to-token replacement and optional comment handling for code preprocessing
replace_tokens: replace characters in a string with special token values from a given dictionary
indent_lines: indent a list of tokenized lines using bracket tokens to reconstruct proper code indentation
